view.lede: The Ring, left-handed: one of the five generic courses that every course without its own build races on for now (very tight, near-circular). A tight stadium oval of about a mile with a short run-in (about 1½f): no straight course, the sprints go round, chutes for the 6f, 7f and the long trips. Dressed as a floodlit stadium.
notes: About 8.5f round, a 1.27f run-in. Drawn from a few numbers (the corners and bends of the loop, the chutes), so it can be reshaped quickly.
Floodlit stadium: medium and smaller pieces from the grandstand crib sheet on one front line, the crowd up to the rail; the festival in the infield opposite and up the stand side.
Choose Medium or Low under Quality in the race view's bar. Auto steps down by itself.
